description: [read-only] Returns the full definitions (description and input schema) of every tool in one toolset, so you can call them. Call them by name, or through call_tool if your client only calls listed tools. To list a toolset on every connection, add ?toolsets=core,<name> to the MCP URL.

name.description: The toolset, e.g. "ads". One of: core, publishing, campaigns, analytics, insights, studio, ads, stores, ops.

name: enable_toolset
title: Load a toolset
